summary: Phase 5 LED Module Calculator - All 14 features verified successfully. Pure frontend calculator with dynamic recalculation via useMemo. Default values work (3000x2000mm, 500x500 module, P2.5 → 6x4=24 modules, 1200x800px resolution). All interactive features functional: unit switcher (mm/cm/ft), pixel pitch change, module size change, reset button. 6 FAQs expand/collapse, 11-row reference table, 6 related tools in sidebar, Design Assist CTA. LED Module Calculator appears in Tools mega-menu with Grid3X3 icon. Mobile responsive on 390px viewport. Sitemap includes /led-calculator.

Hero section with title 'LED Module & Cabinet Calculator'
Input panel with all fields: target width, height, module size, pixel pitch
Default values correct: width=3000, height=2000, module=500x500 (idx 3), pitch=P2.5 (idx 5)
Default results: 6 modules wide, 4 modules high, 24 total modules
Actual dimensions: 3000mm x 2000mm (3.00m x 2.00m)
Resolution: 1200x800px (0.96 MP)

Reference table has 11 rows with pitch/module combinations
6 FAQ accordions present (faq-item-0 through faq-item-5)

Module size change recalculates: 500x500→250x250 changes to 96 modules (12x8)
Reset button restores all default values and results
Related tools sidebar has 6 links (calculator, viewing-distance, power-estimator, budget-estimator, installation-guide, project-planner)
Design Assist CTA link visible and navigates to /design-assist
LED Module Calculator appears in Tools mega-menu with Grid3X3 icon
Navbar link data-testid='nav-tools-led-calculator' works
Mobile responsive on 390px viewport - all elements visible and interactive
Sitemap /api/sitemap.xml contains /led-calculator entry
